text: …　そうね　おとこのこは　いつか　たびに　でるもの　なのよ　うん…　テレビの　はなしよ！

structure.jp: テレビの　はなしよ！

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.span: でる　もの　なのよ
patterns.explanation: ものだ states how things naturally are. なのよ is a soft, feminine ending. たびに　でるものなのよ = 'it's just what they do, go on journeys'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after a place or goal with でる says what you go out to. たびに　でる = 'set out on a journey'.
